query:
UPDATE garage_vehicles v
        SET state = jsonb_set(v.state, '{hits}', COALESCE((
            SELECT jsonb_agg(h)
            FROM jsonb_array_elements(v.state->'hits') h
            WHERE NOT ((h->>0) ILIKE ANY(g.hitpoints))
        ), '[]'::JSONB)),
        updated = NOW()
        FROM garage_repair_groups g
        WHERE v.plate = $1 AND g.id = $2
